description: The starting values of a new project's profile file (design §6): the defaults that `harness init` offers for its questions, and the values the bootstrap writes where the answers, the schema's defaults and the selected adapters' defaults leave a role empty. The term lists are derived from the answers.

plan.phasesWithFragments: every phase: each task writes its own log `<task id>.log.md` beside its task file in the phase folder (template: `harness/core/plan/task-log-template.md`); a phase of the older layout keeps its fragments in `work-logs/phase-<n>/`
plan.estimationScale: story points (SP), Fibonacci; 1 SP is about half a developer-day or one focused agent session; estimates include the tests the definition of done requires
plan.resumePhrases: "Start Phase N", "Continue Phase N", "Work the issue queue", "Fix I-<n>"; the phrase approves the pull requests of the named phases and issues
